fact: The African Telecommunications Union Conference of Plenipotentiaries (CPL-26, Abuja, 23-24 July 2026) elected Eng. Kezias Kazuba Mwale of Zambia as Secretary General with 21 of 34 votes in the fourth round, to take office on 1 January 2027 for four years.

Zambia's Minister of Technology and Science, Felix C. Mutati, spoke at the close of the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja, which Member States including Zambia's delegation attended on 23-24 July 2026.

Delegates at the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries (CPL-26, Abuja, closed 24 July 2026) elected Engr. Kezias Kazuba Mwale of Zambia as the Union's next Secretary-General with 21 of 34 votes in the final round, taking office on 1 January 2027 for four years.

The ATU's own release states that its Conference of Plenipotentiaries (Abuja, 23-24 July 2026) elected Eng. Kezias Kazuba Mwale of Zambia as Secretary General with 21 of 34 votes in the fourth round, to take office on 1 January 2027 for four years.
Zambia's Minister of Technology and Science, Felix C. Mutati, spoke at the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja concluded on 24 July 2026.
